title: Site Clinic build snapshot
description: One record of what the build-time gates measured, for one build of one site. Produced by gate-snapshot. This is an evidence artifact, not a verdict: a snapshot records what was measured, including failures, and is never itself a pass.

snapshotId.description: Content address over (domain, commitSha, buildId, environment, gateConfigHash, per-gate outcomes and check results). Deliberately excludes capturedAt so two merges of the same build are identical and an ingestion endpoint can treat a re-POST as a no-op.

domain.description: Hostname from gate.config.json baseUrl. Null when unresolvable.

gateConfigHash.description: Hash of measurement SCOPE (routes, expected gates, scope-affecting config). Changes when what is measured changes; stable across runs otherwise. A change means totals moved for scope reasons, not necessarily quality.

commitSha.description: Never invented. Null when it cannot be established.

environment.description: A local or preview snapshot must never be represented as production evidence.

status.description: partial when any expected gate did not run or any fragment was malformed. A partial snapshot establishes a floor, never a clean bill of health.

gates.description: Keyed by gate name. A gate that did not run is present with outcome not_run - never omitted, never rendered as an empty passing record.

outcome.description: pass/fail derive from the gate's real exit code. error means the gate could not complete a measurement (e.g. a route would not load), which is distinct from measuring a failure. not_run means no fragment existed.

adaScanMode.description: html-snapshot mode cannot evaluate color-contrast (JSDOM has no canvas-backed layout). Comparing axe counts across modes reads measurement loss as improvement.
